epics.description: Integration of inclusivity evaluation tools directly into the Workday Recruiting environment to provide recruiters with immediate, actionable feedback during the job requisition creation process.
epics.out_of_scope: Modifications to Workday's core approval workflows or external job board integrations.
epics.name: Integrated Workday Inclusivity Experience
epics.in_scope: Workday UI integration, real-time feedback loops, pre-submission scoring triggers, and optional scoring toggles.

epics.name: Global Inclusivity Scoring Engine
epics.in_scope: ML model training for multiple languages, configurable scoring parameters (country/job type), and recalculation logic for existing requisitions.
epics.description: Development and expansion of the ML-based scoring engine to support diverse languages and configurable logic based on regional or job-specific requirements.
epics.out_of_scope: Scoring for non-text based assets or non-supported languages.

epics.description: Management of GenAI-driven recommendations, ensuring recruiters and managers maintain control over the final output through manual reviews and overrides.
epics.out_of_scope: Fully automated updates without human review.
epics.name: Human-in-the-Loop Recommendation Management
epics.in_scope: Recommendation generation, recruiter acceptance/rejection workflows, and manager override capabilities.

epics.description: Establishing a secure, scalable, and compliant backend infrastructure for data persistence and API access.
epics.in_scope: Data encryption, audit logging, historical trend storage, and secure RESTful API endpoints.
epics.name: Data Governance and Secure Infrastructure

epics.description: Refinement of the Workday job requisition interface to improve user efficiency by removing unnecessary complexity.
epics.name: Workday UI Optimization
epics.in_scope: Analysis of unused fields, automated data population, and UI cleanup within Workday.
epics.out_of_scope: Redesigning the entire Workday Recruiting module.

reasoning_log.reasoning: Groups all items related to the recruiter's direct interaction within the Workday interface.
Consolidates the core ML engine capabilities and the requirement to expand into global, multi-language support.
Addresses the conflict between F-0002 (English only) and SIG-010/011 (Multi-language) by treating the requirement as an enhancement.
Created as a Gap Resolution story because the specific fields to be removed are currently undefined in the requirements.

stories.tasks: Establish bi-directional API connection between Workday and AWS, Embed scoring UI components in Workday requisition screen, Implement real-time trigger for text analysis during entry.
stories.user_story: As a Recruiter, I want to see inclusivity feedback while I am drafting a job requisition so that I can make improvements before submitting for approval.
stories.title: Real-time Inclusivity Feedback in Workday UI
stories.description: Integrate the inclusivity scoring service directly into the Workday UI to replace the need for an external portal. Feedback must be instantaneous to support the creation workflow.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a recruiter is on the Workday job requisition creation screen, When they enter text into the job description, Then the system must display real-time inclusivity scores and GenAI recommendations before the requisition is submitted.

stories.user_story: As a Hiring Manager, I want the ability to choose whether to trigger inclusivity scoring so that I can manage the workflow during the pilot phase.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the job requisition screen, When a manager or recruiter starts a new requisition, Then they must have the option to enable or disable the inclusivity scoring trigger.
stories.title: Optional Inclusivity Scoring Trigger
stories.description: Provide a toggle or optional trigger for inclusivity scoring to allow for flexibility during the pilot phase and for specific use cases where scoring may not be required.
stories.tasks: Add 'Enable Inclusivity Analysis' toggle to Workday UI, Update API logic to respect the optional trigger status.

stories.user_story: As a Global Recruiter, I want the system to analyze job postings in multiple languages so that we can ensure inclusivity across all our operating regions.
stories.title: Multi-Language ML Inclusivity Analysis
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a job description in English, French, German, Italian, or Portuguese, When the scoring engine is invoked, Then it must provide a composite score and category-specific signals in the corresponding language.
stories.tasks: Train/Fine-tune GenAI model for 5 supported languages, Update scoring algorithm to handle multi-language linguistic nuances, Validate category-specific signals for each language.
stories.description: Enhance the ML engine to support five languages (English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese) for job postings across 10 countries. This overrides the initial English-only constraint.
The scoring logic must be flexible enough to account for different definitions of inclusivity based on job type and geographic location.
stories.tasks: Define configuration schema for country-specific scoring rules, Update ML engine to ingest and apply metadata-based logic, Create administrative interface for managing scoring parameters.
stories.title: Configurable Scoring Logic by Region and Job Type
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a job requisition, When the scoring engine is triggered, Then it must apply logic specific to the Job Type, Country, and Region metadata provided.
stories.user_story: As a Regional Talent Lead, I want the scoring logic to reflect local inclusivity standards so that the feedback is relevant to my specific market.

stories.system_tags: AWS API Layer, AWS Compute Layer
stories.user_story: As a Recruiter, I want to see an updated score immediately after I edit a job description so that I can verify my improvements.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given an existing job requisition that is being edited, When the text is modified, Then the system must allow for a fresh score recalculation within 3 seconds.
stories.title: Score Recalculation for New and Existing Requisitions
stories.description: Support immediate score updates for both brand new requisitions and existing ones that are undergoing modifications.
stories.tasks: Implement recalculation trigger on text change, Ensure performance latency remains < 3 seconds for existing reqs, Update Workday UI to reflect recalculated scores.

stories.user_story: As a Recruiter, I want to receive specific suggestions to improve my job posting so that I can take immediate action to make it more inclusive.
stories.title: Actionable Recommendation Generation and Review
stories.tasks: Develop recommendation generation logic, Build UI for Accept/Reject workflow in Workday, Implement tracking for recommendation acceptance status.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given an inclusivity analysis result, When recommendations are generated, Then the recruiter must be able to manually accept or reject each suggestion within the Workday UI.
stories.description: Generate actionable recommendations based on the 22 features. Implement a human-in-the-loop requirement where recruiters must review suggestions.

stories.acceptance_criteria: Given a manager reviewing a requisition, When they disagree with an automated score or suggestion, Then they must be able to override the score and provide custom input based on local requirements.
stories.description: Enable managers to provide custom scoring and override automated suggestions to account for local nuances not captured by the ML engine.
stories.title: Manager Override and Custom Scoring
stories.tasks: Implement override functionality in the Workday UI, Create data fields to store 'Manager Adjusted' scores, Log reasons for overrides for future model improvement.
stories.user_story: As a Hiring Manager, I want to override automated suggestions so that I can apply local knowledge that the system might have missed.

stories.title: Secure Inclusivity Data Repository
stories.description: Establish a persistent data store for scores, feature results, and historical trends for audit purposes. Ensure strict security and privacy compliance.
stories.user_story: As a Compliance Officer, I want to ensure that all inclusivity data is stored securely and without PII so that we meet data privacy standards.
stories.tasks: Configure encrypted database for historical scoring data, Implement PII filtering to ensure no candidate data is stored, Develop audit logging for score changes.
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the inclusivity data repository, When scores are stored, Then they must be encrypted at rest and in transit, and no candidate PII must be present.

stories.user_story: As a Recruiter, I want a cleaner requisition screen with fewer unused fields so that I can complete the creation process more efficiently.
stories.title: Workday Requisition Screen Field Analysis
stories.acceptance_criteria: Given the list of fields on the Workday job requisition screen, When the streamlining project begins, Then a finalized list of 'unused' fields and 'automated' fields must be documented and approved.
stories.tasks: Conduct audit of current Workday requisition fields, Identify fields for removal or automation with stakeholders, Document technical requirements for automated data population.
stories.description: Identify which fields in the current Workday requisition screen are unused or can be automated to streamline the user experience. This is a gap resolution story to define the undefined scope in SIG-004.
